rna.text: Medge shows her students a motionless elder monk and then takes her eight students beyond the safe waters to watch a krasis in action.
A rasping voice draws Medge, Kaszira and Miko into a wreck where a ghost named Andrik asks to be taken home, and Medge agrees to help him reach the surface as the students refloat the ship.

At the zonot Andrik reveals himself as a pirate and the trunk proves to hold stolen Simic treasure, which the class brings to the guardians, who recognize Momir Vig's stolen keyrune, but Miko's fin then knocks the cytoplast loose and it mutates Medge, and she and her students are tossed into the zonot's brig.

Speaker Zegana bans Kaszira and her friends from the zonots, though Medge pleads that Kaszira be allowed to study, and at the showing every student except Miko and Kaszira is placed in the protectorate, after which Medge and Ptero reconcile and agree to tend their clutches together next year.
